endorsements.quote: Vulnerability scanning: Regularly scanning federated learning infrastructure for vulnerabilities and applying necessary patches.
Data encryption: Ensuring that data is encrypted both in transit and at rest across all participating sites.

A more rigorous evaluation is required, encompassing “white hat” intrusion testing and vulnerability assessments to identify and address potential weaknesses before broader researcher access is granted.
Authentication and authorization: Implementing secure authentication and authorization protocols to control access to federated learning resources.
Audit trails and review: Establishing comprehensive audit trails to track data access and system activity.
Developing a versioning system before starting a cycle of federated learning is incredibly important for both debugging and provenance.

unlisted_practices: Evaluate whether federated learning will improve model performance through a cost-benefit analysis before starting an FL project.
Engage IT, security and compliance teams and an executive sponsor early in FL projects.
Draft a written Federation Agreement covering data-protection role allocation, access tiering, access committee workflow, and withdrawal and incident reporting conditions.
Plan and test federated unlearning with defined triggers and rollback to pre-event checkpoints.
Document the differential privacy budget and expected utility loss per node so privacy protections do not disproportionately degrade models for under-resourced sites.
Document a breach and model poisoning response plan including model rollback.
Prototype FL pipelines with synthetic or open datasets at two sites and stress test with models of escalating complexity using continuous integration testing.
Safeguard federated learning against model poisoning and batch effects through anomaly detection and performance monitoring.
Set usage limits or charge-back agreements to prevent economic denial of sustainability from excessive compute jobs.
Lock data and model standards and record code and dataset versions in training metadata before large-scale learning cycles.
Collect site team experience periodically and perform anonymized descriptive analyses and offline verification to evaluate the utility of the federation.
Maintain living, versioned documentation of governance, security audits, procedures and emergency plans accessible to all participants to reduce bus-factor risk.
Explain FL technology and ethical risks to IRBs and institutional counsel with supporting documentation.
